data.title: 远坂凛 · 魔术工坊的深红兔女郎试穿
data.description: 深夜远坂邸地下魔术工坊内，红宝石在炼金台前泛着温润的魔术光芒。凛反向跨坐在高背木椅上，身着合身紧致的深红乳胶兔女郎服，头顶兔耳微偏，双手搭在椅背边缘。深红衣装勾勒出柔美腰线，锁骨与双肩在暖调灯光下格外细腻。她微微撅起嘴唇，双颊染着傲娇的红晕直视前方的你——「笨蛋！明明是魔术礼装的适应性测试……你在看哪里啊！敢乱想的话，直接用宝石魔术把你轰飞！」
data.action: 反向跨坐于工坊木椅，双手搭在椅背，身穿深红兔女郎服，双颊微红傲娇直视观众
data.lighting: 红宝石灼热魔力光芒与古典暖黄油灯
data.camera: front view, eye level, medium shot
data.mood: 名门大小姐的自信高雅与暗夜魅力
data.promptProse: Rin Tohsaka sits backwards astride a wooden chair inside her family study at night, both hands resting along the chair back as she faces the viewer with flushed cheeks and a proud pout. Dressed in a glossy crimson strapless corset bunny suit with bunny ears, bowtie, and black thighhighs, she is illuminated by glowing magic rubies and a warm amber oil lamp.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a glossy crimson strapless corset bunny suit with high-cut hips, matching bunny ears, a crisp bowtie, and sheer black thighhighs.
data.animaCaption: Sitting backwards astride a wooden study chair with both hands gripping the backrest, she wears a glossy crimson strapless bunny suit and black thighhighs while facing the viewer with a flushed, haughty pout. Glowing red rubies and a warm oil lamp gleam across the glossy bodice.
